goal: Close cycle3 product MVP on Android by proving end-user flow on emulator and physical device: write/save/restart/re-query/universe/auth fallback/lifecycle.

inputs.description: Automation runner for auth/device precheck and evidence template generation.

constraints.notes: Report both canonical root and alias workspace availability. Do not expose raw token/admin key values.

acceptance: Emulator and physical-device runs both contain product journey pass evidence: write/save/re-query/universe/lifecycle.
Auth fallback scenarios are explicit with status proof: empty token 401 and forbidden audience token 403.
ANDROID_REPORT.md and evidence markdown are updated with reproducible commands and sanitized paths.

risk.note: UI-coordinate drift and manual token operations can cause false negatives unless automation runner is used.

next_actions: Run tools/android_cycle3_product_mvp_runner.ps1 in all mode and attach generated json/markdown outputs.
Execute product journey on emulator then physical device and capture screenshots/logcat snippets.
Publish android cycle03 result artifact with pass/fail matrix and blocker class if any.
